universal_reductions: Formal-series reconstruction and refinement by unique Euclidean division.
Root selector by finite geometric sum over a characteristic-zero field containing a primitive root.
Fibonacci stride recurrence by Cayley-Hamilton for T^M.
Causal FIR routing by finite reindexing; composition by associativity/conjugation.
Haar inverse and energy by A^T A=I with the explicitly stated pair convention.
Lifting inverse by reversing the triangular operations.
Streaming by induction on retained histories; resampling by substitution of the zero-inserted support.
Catalan formal quadratic expansion; Stirling-row EGF expansion; Bernoulli reciprocal coefficients; partition multiplicity product; divisor and binary-digit identities.
